app.description: Professional tool for encoding and decoding Base64

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: This Base64 Tool is a client-side application that processes all data locally in your browser.
We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data or the content you encode/decode.
All encoding and decoding operations are performed entirely on your device without any server communication.
We do not use cookies for tracking purposes. The only data stored locally are your preferences (theme and language settings).
No analytics or third-party tracking services are integrated into this application.
Your privacy is fully protected as no data ever leaves your browser.
